title: Where Did the $5.5 Million Come From? The Black Family Partners Source-of-Funds Gap
core_finding: The Nov. 30, 2012 Financial Trust receipt identifies Black Family Partners, Bank of America, and originator account 000001200135. October 3 records independently identify 000001200135 as a Black Family Partners BofA account. The immediate source of the Nov. 30 balance remains unresolved.

sources.supports: $5,500,030 CHIPS credit; BFP as ordering party; Bank of America; originator account 000001200135.
sources.limit: Receiving-side record; does not show buyer balance or antecedent credits.

sources.supports: Account 000001200135 belongs to BFP and handled large internal transfers; packet includes separate source-of-funds material for Phaidon investment.
sources.limit: October activity cannot be assigned as source of Nov. 30 payment without intervening ledger.

sources.supports: $5.5M aggregate package price and Nov. 30 closing target.
sources.limit: Does not identify buyer funding source.

sources.supports: Financial Trust November account context and ending-value increase.
sources.limit: Seller-side statement, not buyer funding proof.

open_questions: Where is the Nov. 30, 2012 Bank of America debit advice for BFP account 000001200135?
Where is the November 2012 statement for BFP account 000001200135?
What credits and debits occurred between Oct. 3 and Nov. 30?
What Black Family Partners accounting entry records the purchase and funding source?
not_established: That Apollo Credit Opportunity Fund funded the Nov. 30 purchase.
That art-sale proceeds or Neuberger & Berman liquidation proceeds funded the Nov. 30 purchase.
That any Oct. 3 inflow remained in the account through Nov. 30.
That the transaction constituted laundering, fraud, concealment, or a sham.
